reviews.note: Cuba about to be liberated, restated at the close of the broadcast.
An intelligence director's visit to Cuba noted as significant, with the island's dimensions worked out on air.
Not done with America, given while singing the Battle Hymn.
Raises the benchmark from Azusa to greater than any of the great awakenings, and adds that the sky is not falling.
New claim. Given alongside four named states to be shaken, which is the checkable half of the passage.
The rebirthing repeated with the founding fathers seen.
Adds that America remains a sheep nation and that the cleansing starts behind the pulpits.
A great British Columbia earthquake with many more after it, and secession attempts following.
Extends the shaking to England, Japan and the Vatican alongside the Catholic Church.
New claim. A breakthrough rather than a closure, which is the opposite direction from his other strait material.
Adds Chinese involvement and puts Cuba next in sequence, which makes the ordering checkable.
He notes the statement will be unpopular and says he fears God not man rather than softening it.
A sung worship passage.
Adds that the church does not represent a country and rejects a bipartisan reconciliation reading. Notable as a de-politicising statement inside a heavily political broadcast.
Accuracy framed as what lets people catch it, with a statement that he does not see the church as national.
New claim. Four denominations named and the movement said not to involve a government.
Extends the covering to the secretary of state, the vice president and a named candidate.
Adds Jezebel and octopus tentacles around the mind. The claim concerns spirits, so it cannot be checked directly.
New claim, and he says the meeting had not yet taken place when he saw it, which makes the timing checkable if the meeting is ever identified.
New claim. He says he does not know what it means, so the image is open to later attachment.
Adds the aircraft overflights searching for the shielded device.
He says he does not know what lead would do, which is an admission about the physics of his own claim.
Adds the latch and key detail and dates it to the 1970s. He dates the same object to the 1960s elsewhere.
Two hundred dollar oil and 1970s style fuel queues, with a not financial advice disclaimer attached.
Work from home instructions treated as the restrictions returning.
Speculation about a resignation after a meeting with the king.
New claim, and a clean binary: he was asked which stops first and answered Ukraine and Russia rather than Iran. The June 2026 Iran ceasefire settles it the other way while the Ukraine war continued.
The lavender identification is supplied by his co-host from footage rather than from the vision, which is worth recording.
Peace called over both countries with an agreement asked for.
He says he does not know whether Russia is known for lavender, which is a check on his own detail.
The lavender repeated within the same minute.
Adds purple, stars and diamonds on the breath as the Russians exhale in relief.
Turkey unsatisfied and stirred up by the prospect of peace.
He says he does not know what he is seeing and is reporting it raw, which is the right form and is worth recording.
Sets the order as peace first then the novel weapon over Poland, which means a ceasefire confirms rather than refutes the claim.
A reprieve used to rebuild before starting again, with a timing range of months to four years that he states he does not know.
Adds a negotiation and handshake on the Clarity Act over bank objections, which is a specific outcome rather than a standoff.
Names the same four banks that appear across several separate bank claims in this corpus.
New claim. A statement of his own position rather than a prediction, and worth having on record given how much of the corpus is about a political figure.
New claim, and the most useful thing he says about his own record: a durable index of the big words is exactly what would make the claims checkable.
He clarifies the scope, that the 350 million is not America and not one nation, which narrows the claim rather than widening it.
New claim. Three named living people moving in three specified directions, which is among the most checkable items in the corpus.
Refinery fires claimed as called. Refinery strikes were already the established pattern of the war by this date.
Adds a green biological weapon out of the water with a Russian submarine, and rockets at the Vatican.
He says plainly he is still looking for the black swan, which is an honest open ledger entry, and adds the Olympic ski slopes.
Psalm 23 prayed. No forward content.
Extends the dry bones question to America, Europe and Australia, starting with pastors.
New claim. No reading is offered.
An opening greeting to viewers.
He says the instruction was to his father and not to him, and that each person must follow what they are told. Individualising it means no outcome tests it.
A major Californian church leader shaken with things exposed, dated to the days ahead.
New claim. The condition means an absent revival is attributable to the hearers rather than to the word.
Revival prayed over Australia with the audience nations covered.
Protection prayed over the Taiwanese people and their finances.
Worm and cricket burgers pushed as an alternative protein across America.
